basic_profile.bio: I'm a 24-year-old graphic design enthusiast from Portland, Oregon. I recently graduated from college with a degree in visual arts and I'm currently freelancing while exploring different digital tools. I'm passionate about technology and love discovering new apps that can enhance my productivity. In my free time, I enjoy horseback riding and playing casual video games. I'm usually online in the evenings, Pacific Time. Currently single and enjoying the freedom to explore new hobbies and interests.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Having a visual arts degree, I have a solid foundation in design principles and digital art tools. Most of my knowledge comes from formal education, but I've been expanding into digital productivity tools through online tutorials and self-exploration.
